title: Analytics Retirement Overview
content_html:
Analytics Retirement Overview

Final State

The standalone Analytics application was retired after its durable responsibilities reached their final owners:

  • Studio owns canonical tags, aliases, groups, assignments, tag policy, services, APIs, transactions, activity integration, and retained browser workflows.
  • Integrated Docs Viewer owns document-package preparation, return, review, and import.
  • Tag-package sharing and the generic Data Sharing framework remain retired.

There is no Analytics runtime, configuration, server, runner, route registry, API namespace, or test/check family.

Current Authority

  • Tag Source Data
  • Tag Services
  • Local Studio Routes
  • Local Studio APIs
  • Source Tree Ownership

The public /analysis/ scope is a Docs Viewer knowledge surface. Its route name does not preserve or imply the former application.

Maintenance Rule

New tag work belongs to Studio. New document-package work belongs to integrated Docs Viewer. A concrete future visualisation or report belongs with the domain that owns its source and workflow; it is not a reason to recreate a generic Analytics app.
